messages:
Simon (support): Customer AcmeReports seeing tool call 400 when attaching tool args. Happens from their iOS app only.
Alex (support-engineer): Can you paste the exact request body / curl? Prefer sanitized payload.
Simon (support): Here's sanitized curl they sent:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/toolcall \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{\"tool\":\"file_reader\",\"args\":"'{'\\"path\\":\\"/private/var/mobile/Containers/data.txt\\",}'" }'
```
Priya (sdk): ugh nested single quotes + inner JSON uses single quotes and trailing comma. Also client paste may include BOM (\uFEFF) from iOS copy/paste which ends up as a leading byte in the string. Both will break JSON.parse on our side.
Marta (platform): Server log excerpt:
```
ERROR parse_toolargs: Unexpected token '\\'' at position 0
400 "Tool args parsing failed: invalid JSON"
```
Alex (support-engineer): Repro steps: iPhone Safari paste of JSON into our SDK textarea -> submit -> 400. I reproduced locally by pasting a BOM + single-quoted inner JSON + trailing comma into our JS SDK.
Alex (support-engineer): Quick mitigation idea — strip leading BOM and any ZWNBSP/zero-width chars, detect common smart quotes and normalize. If outer is a string and inner looks like JSON, attempt a safe normalize/fallback parse (log and rate-limit fallbacks).
Priya (sdk): SDK fix plan: sanitize pasted text in the TextView (replace smart quotes, remove leading \uFEFF, replace trailing comma in object/array if obviously accidental). Also validate and show explicit client-side error: "Tool args must be a JSON object or a base64 string." Will open PR for iOS and Android.
Marta (platform): For server-side, we should NOT silently accept mutated JSON, but a defensive parser that provides a better error message is good. Add a diagnostic header when we detect "looks-like-pasted-json" so support can tell customers exactly what's wrong.
Alex (support-engineer): For immediate support reply, give customer this workaround and example of correct payload:
```
{
  "tool": "file_reader",
  "args": {
    "path": "/private/var/mobile/Containers/data.txt"
  }
}
```
Simon (support): Sent workaround to customer and asked them to send exact curl if still failing. Creating internal ticket INF-4921 and assigning to eng-oncall.
eng-oncall-bot: Ticket INF-4921 created and assigned to priya. ETA 48h. :eyes:
Alex (support-engineer): I'll add unit tests for the parser to cover leading BOM, single-quoted inner JSON, and trailing-comma cases. Marking this P2. :thumbsup:
Marta (platform): Noting for rollout: add a rollout gate for a diagnostic header and small parser soft-fix, monitor errors for 72h before any lenient parsing.
Priya (sdk): PR created: ios/sdk#1287 - sanitize paste + explicit error UI.
Simon (support): Will follow up with customer tomorrow. Closing thread here for now. :pray:
